title: S. Radhakrishnan
summary: Defends the Objectives Resolution as a necessary declaration for peaceful transformation, popular sovereignty, rights and national unity.

title: N. V. Gadgil
summary: Treats the Constituent Assembly as part of the freedom struggle and links the Union, fundamental rights and economic justice.

title: Vijayalakshmi Pandit
summary: Connects Indian independence with Asian anti-imperial struggles and India's potential role in a freer international order.

title: N. G. Ranga
summary: Argues that constitutional rights need material conditions and institutional enforcement if workers, peasants and poor citizens are to use them.

title: S. Nagappa
summary: Presses for equality of opportunity to become actual political participation and representation for historically excluded communities.
